hero.heading: Building Partnerships Building Dreams
hero.paragraph: We believe in collaborative design, working closely with clients to understand their vision and bring it to life. Our expertise in architectural design and project management ensures seamless execution from concept to completion.

about.aboutParagraph:
PT.SSI was established during a period of downturn in China's infrastructure and real estate sectors, while industrial parks and construction in Indonesia are thriving.
It integrates resources from a professional technical team from China and a consulting team from Indonesia, complementing each other's strengths.
The company aims to meet the needs of various foreign investors looking to establish factories in Indonesia by providing professional technical services, consulting services,
supervision services, and assistance with construction permit procedures that are tailored to Indonesia's national conditions.
The goal is to offer a range of specialized services to investors, addressing their concerns regarding design, consulting, supervision, and approval processes.

services.servicesParagraph:
We provide comprehensive services to help your business
thrive in today's competitive landscape.

servicesItems.title: Design Services
servicesItems.description: Industrial projects mainly target various industrial parks, factories, and supporting buildings; civil projects mainly target villas, residences, office buildings, etc.

servicesItems.title: Design Consulting and Optimization
servicesItems.description: Optimize domestic drawings according to Indonesian conditions to save costs.

servicesItems.title: Drawing Conversion Services
servicesItems.description: If drawings are designed by Chinese design institutes commissioned by the owner, we are responsible for translating them into Indonesian and reviewing before stamping, assuming responsibility and risk.

servicesItems.title: Approval and Construction Permits
servicesItems.description: Handle approval procedures such as environmental impact assessment (EIA), PBG (Building Permit), SLF (Certificate of Feasibility), SLO (Operational License), etc.

servicesItems.title: Supervision
servicesItems.description: Ensure the implementation and realization of design intent.

servicesItems.title: Resource Coordination
servicesItems.description: If needed, also coordinate resources in upstream and downstream industries (steel structure processing, construction, geological survey, crane production, etc.)

footer.footParagraph: Imagine a space that seamlessly blends form and function, where innovation and sustainability work in perfect harmony. That's the SSI promise. We're more than just architects; we're storytellers, crafting narratives in brick and mortar, glass and steel. We believe that every project is an opportunity to create something extraordinary, a space that reflects your unique vision and contributes to a more sustainable world. Partner with us and experience the power of transformative design.

hero.heading: 建立合作伙伴关系，构建梦想
hero.paragraph: 我们相信协作设计，与客户紧密合作，理解他们的愿景并将其实现。我们在建筑设计和项目管理方面的专业知识确保从概念到完成的无缝执行。

about.aboutParagraph:
PT.SSI是在中国基建及地产行业低迷, 印尼产业园区及工业建设如火如荼之际, 由
中国专业技术团队,印尼顾问团队资源整合, 优势互补,为满足来印尼投资的各国资本方投资建厂需求，提供符合印尼国情的专业技术服务、咨询服务, 监理服务,建设
证件手续办理服务的印尼本土公司,旨在为投资方提供各类专业化服务,解决各投资
方在设计、咨询、监理、报批报建等方面的后顾之忧而成立的设计公司。

services.servicesParagraph: 我们提供全面的数字服务，以帮助您的业务在当今竞争激烈的环境中蓬勃发展。

servicesItems.title: 设计业务
servicesItems.description: 工业项目主要针对各类工业园区、厂房及配套建筑；民用项目主要针对别墅、住宅、办公楼等

servicesItems.title: 设计咨询及优化
servicesItems.description: 按印尼国情对国内图纸进行优化，节约成本

servicesItems.title: 转图业务
servicesItems.description: 即图纸若由业主方委托中国设计院设计，我们负责翻译成印尼文及审核后签章，承担责任与风险

servicesItems.title: 监理
servicesItems.description: 保证设计意图的落地与实施

servicesItems.title: 资源协同
servicesItems.description: 若有需要，也可配合进行上下游产业（钢构加工、施工、地勘、行车生产等）的资源协同

footer.footParagraph: 想象一下，一个空间完美融合了形式与功能，创新与可持续发展和谐共存。这就是 SSI 的承诺。我们不仅仅是建筑师；我们是故事的讲述者，用砖瓦、玻璃和钢铁谱写着动人的篇章。我们相信，每个项目都是创造非凡的契机，一个能够反映您独特愿景并为更可持续的世界做出贡献的空间。与我们携手，体验变革性设计的魅力。
